meta.name: loop-me
meta.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你梳理工作流需求并反复打磨细节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要把模糊想法变成可执行的工作流
copy.tagline_en: Help you clarify workflow requirements and refine details iteratively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn vague ideas into actionable workflows

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过一轮轮提问帮你梳理工作流需求，每次只问一个问题并给出推荐答案，最终产出 workflow 规格文件。
howto.when: 当你告诉 Claude 你想设计一个工作流，或者它发现你生活中存在可自动化的重复模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个每天早上整理待办事项的工作流。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，逐步明确触发条件、检查点等细节。

say.text: 我每周都要手动汇总团队周报，能自动化吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析这个重复模式，并引导你定义工作流规格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a stateful grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, producing workflow specs in `workflows/*.md`.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you tell Claude you want to design a workflow, or when it identifies a recurring pattern in your life worth automating.

say_en.text: Design a workflow that organizes my to-dos every morning.
say_en.note: Claude will start grilling to define triggers, checkpoints, etc.

say_en.text: I manually compile weekly team reports. Can it be automated?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the loop and guide you to specify the workflow.
